# Text engine (RE notes)

Original ROM: `1801 - Kidou Senshi Gundam Seed Destiny (J)(Caravan).gba`, 8 MiB, CRC32 AA250CCA,
SHA-1 64eea52cd909669a972c091869c5f47865863bc0, header `SEEDDESTINY` / B42J / maker B2. Save: EEPROM_V124
(so keep the ROM <= 16 MiB). Game is a 2D fighter; menus are mostly English already.

## Encoding (`tbl/jp.tbl`, generated by `tools/mktbl.py`)
- 1 byte per glyph of the main font: 00 space-ish `＿`, 01 ▼, 02-1B A-Z, 1C-35 a-z, 36-85 hiragana (gojuon, then
  small ゃゅょっ, voiced, ぱ-row, small ぁ-ぉ), 86-D6 katakana (same order + ヴ).
- `ED xx` = kanji bank (archive 6.12, 146 glyphs, some duplicates: suffixed ₂/₃ in the table).
- `EC xx` = symbol bank (archive 6.13: 0-9 . ! ? ・ … - ' ｡ : 〈 〉 。 、 ー ～ 「 」). `EC FF` = print a number variable.
- Control codes (parser 0x08031FF8, jump table 0x08032054 for EE-FF):
  E0 +6 px space, E1 +8 px space, FE line start/newline, FC page, FD wait key, FF end,
  F5/F6 xx xx xx (portrait/speaker), F9 xx xx xx, EE/EF/F4/F7/F8/FA(wait)/FB xx (1 arg), F0-F3 no arg.

## Strings and pointers
- All Japanese script lives in 0xC72F0-0xCC9A8: strings + 30 local pointer tables (514 slots, 514 strings,
  coverage complete: `tools/textmap.py`). Code and meta tables point at the *tables*, never at strings, so the build
  only rewrites table words. Meta: 0x179744 (27 pilot win-quote tables), 0x17937C (network), code literals for
  0xC9530 (shop/unlock, 199) and 0xC9A00 (14).
- 0xC1ED0-0xC7240 is an English script for the embedded bonus game "MS Gundam SEED Battle Assault"
  (its own font layout: caps at 0x0D+, lower at 0x27+). Already English; out of scope.

## Rendering
- Text object (e.g. 0x03000CF0): +4 string table, +8 kern table, +0x28 pos, +0x30/31 x0/y0, +0x32/33 x/y,
  +0x35 glyph slots, +0x37 slot idx, +0x38 string idx, +0x39 state, +0x3B/3C current code, +0x3D lines.
- Init: 0x08031948 (win quotes: x8 y0x62, 75 slots, 3 lines; network 0x55 slots) and 0x08031D2C (shop/menu box,
  17 callers all x8 y0x72, 38 slots).
- Each glyph = one 16x16 OBJ (4bpp, palette 11), tiles at 0x06014000 + slot*0x80, copied from the font cache
  EWRAM 0x02031000 + code*0x80 (cache filled from archive 6.9 / 6.10 / 6.11 at 0x02031000 / 0x02032B00 / 0x02035300
  by 0x08031FA8). EC/ED glyphs are decompressed per glyph into 0x03001BB0.
- Kerning: 0x08033198(obj, code, next) scans the kern table (ROM 0xC7244, pointer literals at 0x031BEC, 0x031EA8):
  entries `code k` or `EC|ED idx k`, FF end, default k=2. Sprite X = x-k, then x += 16-k  =>  advance 16-2k.
  This is the VWF lever: glyph left edge at cell x=k gives a cursor-aligned proportional font.
- Line height 14 px. Glyph style: main colour 13 (D), shadow 4, antialias 7/B/C.

## Archive and compression
- Archive at 0x787970, lookup 0x08000CAC(group, item): u32 group offsets, u16 item offsets (`tools/arc.py`).
- "Le" LZ blocks (`tools/le.py`): 'Le', size24, 00, then 2-bit op groups. Decoder is IWRAM 0x03005C10.
